findings.claim: Current order quantity, price and amount reconcile; those facts do not establish market fairness, bidder independence or lack of improper benefit.
limits: 824.46 USD is ordered value; no payment or loss inference.

findings.claim: Cox's test-site listing is excluded as an executable 906-unit quote.
limits: Its displayed facts can be retained as a catalog observation; 62 units and a test-site header do not support the advertised 500+ tier as an available 906-unit purchase.

findings.claim: Fastener SuperStore's carton prices and pack arithmetic are supported, but the product is only a provisional comparator.
limits: Full carton outlay differs from a prorated 906-piece value.
Quantity capacity, delivery and full technical/compliance equivalence unresolved.

findings.claim: MF Supply's displayed box/piece prices and seven-box stock are supported; pack normalization remains unresolved.
limits: Do not infer pack count from price or weight ratios.
Orders and special conditions require seller acceptance; no government-compliant executable quote established.

findings.claim: The exact authoritative NSN-to-characteristics/revision crosswalk has not been acquired.
limits: ASME B18.24 reference and a blank part-number field do not establish the secondary catalog's full product description.
Failed public retrieval does not prove no public record exists.

findings.claim: Zero qualified comparators and null market premium/overcharge/loss/kickback outputs are appropriate for the current evidence.
limits: A blocked comparison is not a finding of fair pricing or innocence.
No source supports a recurring 12 percent premium or buyer benefit for this cohort.

findings.claim: Reported three-to-five-offer counts are insufficient to test bid spread or independence; actual bid/evaluation records are the discriminating next evidence.
limits: Distinct CAGE/UEI identities and shared upstream part references prove neither collusion nor independence.
A signing official is not assumed to be the person who selected the vendor or price.

findings.claim: The offline calculator reproduces the declared arithmetic and blocks the actual DLA comparison; its flags cannot authenticate the evidence.
limits: Independent review identified order-to-invoice source relabeling; producer corrected the source-kind gate and regression coverage passed.
Public source URLs, availability, independence and reviewer identities remain declared evidence requiring human/source review.

findings.claim: The anonymous annual illustration is algebraically correct and synthetic: increment 100000 at 12 percent implies baseline 2500000/3, gross 2800000/3 and 75/7 percent of gross.
limits: Currency unspecified; no actual transaction, payment, loss or buyer benefit.
Unequal line weights produce 2 percent in the separate fixture, not an unweighted 10 percent.

findings.claim: DOJ/OIG known-case evidence illustrates why actual contractors and correct records cannot exclude bribery; it is calibration only.
limits: Status is dated to the official releases, not asserted current.
No participants or conduct linked to the DLA bolt cohort.
Contract volume is not loss and no per-unit 12 percent mechanism is established.

findings.claim: Catalog differences cannot be converted into a kickback, recoverable loss or price-fairness finding under the present evidence.
limits: Economic comparison and improper-benefit nexus require separate evidence.
No inference of novelty from absence of public enforcement.

findings.claim: Seller margin itself is not a mandatory input to a price comparison; documented material service/term adjustments may be needed.
limits: The matrix gate was corrected accordingly; no cost-or-profit disclosure requirement imposed on these simplified acquisitions.

independent_reconstruction.method: Manual fresh-page checks and separate Python Fraction/Decimal arithmetic, without using the producer's formulas as the expected answer.
checks: Three derivative market captures match manifest byte counts and SHA256 hashes and matrix fields.
All three FSS displayed unit prices agree with independent carton division to displayed precision; normalized values agree within 1e-15.
Fresh Cox row confirms test-site/stock exclusion.
Fresh MF redirected page confirms displayed prices, seven boxes and no explicit pack count; terms confirm acceptance condition.
Uniform fixture independently reconstructed B=200000, A=224000, E=24000, markup 12 percent.
Annual example independently reconstructed exact fractions 2500000/3, 2800000/3 and 75/7 percent.
Actual DLA output has zero eligible lines, no aggregates and null comparison amount.

verification.artifact_limit: Digests of selected factual extractions prove retained-byte integrity, not authenticity of original website bytes. Full current PDFs remain unarchived in the public repository.

next_discriminating_records: Unrestricted primary NSN characteristics and relevant revision/reference qualifiers.
Dated accepted equivalent offer at feasible quantity with freight, certificates and delivery.
Actual quote abstract, evaluation rationale and price-reasonableness record.
Dated role-to-decision evidence and, separately, actual evidence of improper benefit if it exists in lawfully available records.
